# mochinode globals

Installs Node/web globals missing from the bare MochiBerry engine:

- `URL`, `URLSearchParams`
- `TextEncoder`, `TextDecoder`
- `AbortController`, `AbortSignal`
- `setTimeout`, `clearTimeout`, `setInterval`, `clearInterval`, `setImmediate`, `clearImmediate`

Entry point: `script/index.js`. Import is side-effectful but idempotent and never overwrites an existing global.
